title: Enphase Energy Q1 2026 Form 10-Q
excerpt: Q1 2026 revenue was USD 282.9 million, GAAP gross margin was 35.5%, operating cash flow was USD 102.9 million, and cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities were USD 930.6 million.
summary: The SEC-filed quarterly report supports current demand, shipment, margin, cash-flow, liquidity, debt, inventory, purchase-obligation, tariff, and policy-timed revenue analysis for Enphase; SEC submissions show it remains the latest Form 10-Q through 2026-07-27.
